title: Gobble Grid
description: Nib's starving and the garden's full of seeds. Eat every last one before the Glooms catch you. Grab a chili and suddenly they're the ones running. Side tunnels help when it gets tight, and every board you clear gets a bit faster.
instructions: Arrow keys or WASD to move (swipe on a phone). Clear every seed to win the board. Chilis make the Glooms edible for a few seconds. P pauses, M mutes.
